Alpha.description:
### Civilization IV Archipelago Mod Version 0.1 Alpha Test
My first attempt at releasing this mod to the public, with Techsanity and GPsanity options. Expect plenty of problems, but the point is for other people to stress test them out and give me a break for once.

### Installation Instructions:
1. Unzip Civ4-Archipelago-Mod into your Beyond the Sword mod folder (I've been testing it in the My Games one, but theoretically it should also work in the installation folder one; let me know if one or both work or don't work!), make sure the structure is Beyond the Sword/Mods/Civ4-Archipelago-Mod and that there isn't an extra folder in that structure.
2. Install the APWorld as normal.

### Play Instructions:
1. Run the Civilization IV client from Archipelago, but **do not connect from the client**; you'll do so in-game (and eventually I want to remove the ability to connect from the client)
2. Start a new Civ4 Beyond the Sword game as normal--**I highly recommend playing in windowed mode**, since this is an alpha and if the game freezes it can be difficult/impossible to close out of it if it's in full screen mode.
3. When you load in you'll get a popup saying to connect to the Archipelago Server: you do this by opening up the BUG options (the little dragon in the upper-right corner), entering in your information, then clicking "Save and Connect." If the connection is successful you'll get a popup that says "Successfully Connected," and you can play as normal. If you get an error, try connecting again, it most often means you don't have the client open or you're already connected in the client. Occasionally however the connection will be slow and you connect in the client but get an error in-game; in that case disconnect in the client and try again. **If this happens a lot to you let me know!**

### Known Issues:
1. You can still receive techs in Techsanity from ways that aren't traditional research: starting techs from your leader, goody huts, (normal) GP bulbs, and tech trading, and this could lead to duplicates. These are planned to be removed in future updates. Let me know if things break because of them--they shouldn't, but I'm not 100% certain.
2. The settings aren't balanced at all, and it may make you do things like get 9 Great Scientists when all you have is the library or research Satellites before you have any economic techs. The Techsanity Era Gates setting should help the latter, and I'd highly recommend against large GPsanity numbers unless you have a lot of time to kill.
3. I had generation errors when creating solo/near-solo multiworlds and high Techsanity Era Gates values--I never tested with higher values with GPsanity working, but keep that in mind if you're having trouble generating.
4. Sending a victory should work, but that is the one kind of check I haven't tested yet--let me know if victories work, and be ready to release if they don't!
5. Whenever you close and reopen the game/a save file, you need to disconnect the client, and you should close and reopen the client to avoid missing checks. I plan to try and automate this in future updates.
6. There are a lot of debugging messages left in the mod--I removed some of them, but don't expect a clean feed.

If you have any questions, or things I forgot to mention, let me know in the Civilization IV thread in the Archipelago Discord server.

Github for the APWorld: https://github.com/VincentBorchardt/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/civ_4/client/civ_4_client.py

Alpha_0_2.description:
The first major release is here! The main additions are adding Wondersanity options (both world and national separately) and spawning Great People when GPsanity is on. In particular I'd appreciate testing of the Wondersanity stuff, as it's hard to conclusively test that.

### Changelog:
- Two separate Wondersanity options add World Wonders and/or National Wonders into the location pool. Building the wonder sends a location check, and you can build the wonder even if it's obsolete (though you won't get any benefits other than the culture).
- Great People are added to the itempool when GPsanity is enabled. The total number of added great people is half the GPsanity number rounded up per type (so at the default of 3 checks, 2 of each GP type are added). These aren't progression (just useful), so it doesn't fully solve the large check number possibility, but it should help a lot, especially at lower numbers.
- You can't receive technologies from goody huts or normal GP bulbs if Techsanity is enabled.


### Installation Instructions:
1. Unzip Civ4-Archipelago-Mod into your Beyond the Sword mod folder (I've been testing it in the My Games one, but theoretically it should also work in the installation folder one; let me know if one or both work or don't work!), make sure the structure is Beyond the Sword/Mods/Civ4-Archipelago-Mod and that there isn't an extra folder in that structure.
2. Install the APWorld as normal.

### Play Instructions:
1. Run the Civilization IV client from Archipelago, but **do not connect from the client**; you'll do so in-game (and eventually I want to remove the ability to connect from the client)
2. Start a new Civ4 Beyond the Sword game as normal--**I highly recommend playing in windowed mode**, since this is an alpha and if the game freezes it can be difficult/impossible to close out of it if it's in full screen mode.
3. When you load in you'll get a popup saying to connect to the Archipelago Server: you do this by opening up the BUG options (the little dragon in the upper-right corner), entering in your information, then clicking "Save and Connect." If the connection is successful you'll get a popup that says "Successfully Connected," and you can play as normal. If you get an error, try connecting again, it most often means you don't have the client open or you're already connected in the client. Occasionally however the connection will be slow and you connect in the client but get an error in-game; in that case disconnect in the client and try again. **If this happens a lot to you let me know!**

### Gameplay Issues:
1. You can still receive techs in Techsanity from some ways that aren't traditional research: starting techs from your leader and tech trading, and this could lead to duplicates. These are planned to be removed in future updates. Let me know if things break because of them--they shouldn't, but I'm not 100% certain.
2. The settings aren't balanced at all, and it may make you do things like get 9 Great Scientists when all you have is the library or research Satellites before you have any economic techs. The Techsanity Era Gates setting should help the latter, and I'd highly recommend against large GPsanity numbers unless you have a lot of time to kill (though the added Great People in the pool will help).
3. There are a lot of debugging messages left in the mod. I removed some of them, but don't expect a clean feed.
4. When you're trying to select an "obsolete" wonder to build in the city screen, the building options will jump to the top of the building list due to the hacky way I've implemented that ability. I want to fix it eventually, but for now the easiest way to mitigate it is to use the wonder filter on the right side of the city list (the star), which will have it jump back to the start of the wonders, which hopefully won't make it jump. You can also use the "choose what to build next" dialog, or just select it without moving your mouse (use the scroll wheel).

### Technical Issues:
1. I had generation errors when creating solo/near-solo multiworlds with high Techsanity Era Gates values--I never tested with higher values with locations other than Techsanity enabled but keep that in mind if you're having trouble generating.
2. Whenever you close and reopen the game/a save file, you need to disconnect the client, and you should close and reopen the client to avoid missing checks. I plan to try and automate this in future updates.
3. There have been bug reports of items received/obtained while offline not properly appearing in-game and/or being sent to the multiworld when reconnecting. I think this is related to mismatching either mod or APworld versions, but I haven't fully found the root cause yet.

If you have any questions, bug reports, or things I forgot to mention, let me know in [the Civilization IV thread in the Archipelago Discord server](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1326231506682904576).

Github for the APWorld: https://github.com/VincentBorchardt/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/civ_4/
